Reward:

The FBI is offering a reward of up to $150,000 for information leading to the arrest and conviction of Imer Gomez.

Remarks:

Gomez is both a citizen of the United States and of Mexico. He may be living near Puerto Vallarta, Mexico.

Caution:

Imer Gomez is wanted for his alleged involvement in a Ponzi scheme in which he allegedly raised approximately $10 million from investors. From 2021 to 2024, Gomez allegedly solicited investments from more than 400 individuals through three companies, including Helios Venture Fund LLC and K&G Investment Solutions LLC. On July 16, 2025, a federal arrest warrant was issued after he was charged with Wire Fraud.
